reviewer: Codex: first-use lesson, fictional inputs and current native sample review
review_scope: Read all five localized outlines and context notes and both source journals. Current native inspection, normalization, random sampling and Studio Archive finalization pass in ten locale/phase checks within a 186-case regression. Visually inspected both complete unique sample worksheets in two horizontal views each; compared every cell value, type, style, column width, row height and freeze setting across the other eight locale workbooks. The worksheet name varies by locale; canonical column names intentionally remain English. No learner comprehension, voice, browser widget or two-window acceptance is claimed. Professional review decisions remain pending.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title teaches providing a journal, checking how Vera reads it, selecting the requested rows and finding the sample for later examination. The six stages follow the complete first use rather than an isolated sampling feature.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read both fictional journals and this localized context. March has thirteen posting lines from three invoices and two payments, with EUR 4,392 debit and credit totals. The cumulative March-April input has fifteen lines and EUR 4,880 on each side. The natural request specifies five random rows and seed 42. The context explains source headings, row identity and decimal notation.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The current source-bound workflow inspects and normalizes the actual imported journal before sampling. The regression records an exact reviewed mapping for the fictional source; no approved mapping is shipped to the learner. Checkpoints ask which population is selected and require tracing one selected row back to the source. Native preparation and sample closure pass; all review decisions remain pending.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The workflow produces the actual Excel and CSV sample, normalized population, preparation checks and reproducibility record. The repaired native Excel export fits dates, descriptions, headers and source references and freezes posting identifiers for horizontal scrolling. Every selected row matches the preserved source. Finalized declarations retain the three semantic artifact IDs needed by the ordinary Vouching handoff. Canonical Excel headers remain English, as required by this workflow, with the lesson and review summary in the selected language.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Practice reruns selection against the cumulative fifteen-line file while keeping the same five-row size and seed. It teaches checking the changed population and tracing a new sample row; it does not promise that every period must appear in a random sample. The repeat instruction names the real client, journal, period, filters and audit-plan choices, then offers the owning document-verification workflow.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Read the complete it outline and context and its localized native sampling summary. All five versions retain the same first-use sequence and two useful checkpoints. The planned six stages total 390 seconds; processing and questions may extend that target. Technical canonical headers are explained rather than claimed translated.

The original journal is preserved, all selected fields close through CSV and Excel, and sample review remains pending.
